body:
### Summary

According to the documentation running `uv sync` with the `--only-group` flag shouldn't install/build the local project. The logs below show that the opposite is still happening during our CI run:

```
uv sync --only-group lint-format
  shell: /usr/bin/bash -e {0}
  env:
    UV_FROZEN: true
    UV_NO_SYNC: true
    UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS: never
    pythonLocation: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.14.6/x64
    PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.14.6/x64/lib/pkgconfig
    Python_ROOT_DIR: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.14.6/x64
    Python2_ROOT_DIR: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.14.6/x64
    Python3_ROOT_DIR: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.14.6/x64
    LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.14.6/x64/lib
    UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR: /home/runner/work/_temp/uv-python-dir
    UV_CACHE_DIR: /home/runner/work/_temp/setup-uv-cache
Using CPython 3.14.6 interpreter at: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.14.6/x64/bin/python3.14
Creating virtual environment at: .venv
   Building typed-classproperties @ file:///home/runner/work/typed_classproperties/typed_classproperties
Downloading ruff (10.9MiB)
 Downloaded ruff
  × Failed to build `typed-classproperties @
  │ file:///home/runner/work/typed_classproperties/typed_classproperties`
  ├─▶ The build backend returned an error
  ╰─▶ Call to `hatchling.build.build_editable` failed (exit status: 1)
```

Please note that the build backend failure is a known problem with building the local project in our CI environment, which is why the `--only-group` flag is being used in the first place! We don't want to be building the local project.

### Platform

Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS

### Version

Successfully installed uv version 0.12.1 (astral-sh/setup-uv@v9.0.0)

### Python version

Using CPython 3.14.6 interpreter at: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.14.6/x64/bin/python3.14
title: `uv sync --only-group lint-format` is still building & installing local project
